description: blind by Eufrosyne, the winner of the PC 64K intro competition at Assembly '96, in its final version, running from its original files in your browser.
about: blind is Eufrosyne's 64K intro for MS-DOS, which won the PC 64K intro competition at Assembly '96, held from 16 to 18 August 1996 in Helsinki. This is its final version, released on 5 January 1997.
Escape quits and Space fast-forwards; BLIND.NFO says other keys do nothing and “no hidden parts exist.” It returns to DOS by itself after about two and a half minutes.
released: Assembly '96: first in the PC 64K intro competition. The final version was released on 5 January 1997.
credits: Code by Suckho, graphics and music by Duke. Music player MXMPlay by Cubic Team, PMODE by Tran.
terms: BLIND.NFO: “you can spread this intro freely. you can add this intro on any CD-ROM, but please inform us. you must not modify anything in this intro or any files you got with it.”
accuracy: DosKit picks the Gravis UltraSound at port 240h in its setup. BLIND.NFO says its music is not the same on a Sound Blaster.
Its timeline follows a 2007 capture on scene.org within about 0.2 seconds.
Mono: js-dos mixes the two channels into one.
imageAlt: blind by Eufrosyne, running in DosKit
